notes: Epoch 1 emissions: 14,400 MOR/day starting Feb 8 2024, declining 2.46899 MOR/day over ~16 years
The emisions are split 24% each to Compute Providers, Code Contributors, Capital Providers, Application Builders and 4% to Protection Fund.
Onchain MOR supply lags the schedule because mints are sporadic rather than daily on-schedule. The schedule represents the tokens allocated to each bucket.
Tail Emissions (epoch 2) are not modeled, the amounts depend on DAO decisions not yet finalized.
While the emissions started accruing in Feb 8 2024, they became claimable on May 9 2024
